# Mahmood Sultan

> Portfolio of Mahmood Sultan — third-year student at the University of Toronto Mississauga (BA, Technology, Coding & Society + CCIT, Statistics minor, expected Apr 2029), seeking a 12–16 month co-op from May 2027.

Mahmood Sultan is a student developer based in Toronto. This portfolio showcases selected case studies, background, and contact information.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Hero introduction to Mahmood Sultan.
- [About](/#about): Background, education, and experience, including My Code Club (Backend Developer & Curriculum Developer, Jul–Nov 2026) and Agrivanna (Web App QA Tester, Oct–Nov 2026).
- [Selected work](/#work): Case studies for My Code Club, UTM Makerspace Access (CCT204, 4-person team), and Turtle Island Charity, plus shorter projects including OurCal, Toronto Firearm Analysis (CCT416), the Calorie Tracking App, and 100-Level Platformer Game.
- [UTM Makerspace Access](/projects/utm-makerspace): 4-person UX research study on why immigrant ICCIT students didn't use the UTM Library Makerspace.
- [Contact](/#contact): Get in touch with Mahmood.
